An escaped space belongs to the key.
An escaped space is an option key of its own, not a key that trims away.
An escaped space at either end of an option value is text the trimming does not remove.
An escaped space at the start of an inline default is text the trimming does not remove.
An escape sequence claims one code point, so whitespace past an escaped space is still padding.
Whitespace after an escape sequence that claims a colon is still padding around the value.
Whitespace after an escape sequence that claims a colon is still padding around the key.
Over an absent value the shorthand is never compared, because ne takes the fallback chain like every other modifier.
A valueless option is trimmed by the whitespace class, and the value it stands for is the trimmed key.
U+00A0, though typed on purpose, trims away like any other member when it is the whole value.
An author who means U+00A0 as the value escapes it.
U+3000, though typed on purpose, trims away like any other member when it is the whole value.
An author who means U+3000 as the value escapes it.
A run of every member around a key trims like a single one.
An option value made of every member trims away to nothing.
A modifier name and a segment made of every member name nothing, so the placeholder is a plain substitution.
A colon with nothing after it names no modifier, so the placeholder is a plain substitution.
A modifier name that trims away to nothing names no modifier, so the placeholder is a plain substitution.
A colon naming no modifier leaves a placeholder with options to eq.
An empty segment declares no option, so the placeholder is a plain substitution.
A segment that trims away to nothing declares no option, so the placeholder is a plain substitution.
A segment whose key is empty declares no option even with a value, so the placeholder stays a plain substitution.
A placeholder with and without a trailing semicolon, padded or not, is the same placeholder.
An inline default with and without a trailing semicolon, padded or not, declares the same default.
